- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart is considered one of the greatest composers of all time, born in Salzburg, Austria, and composed over 600 works including operas, symphonies, chamber music, and choral works.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Franz Schubert, born in Vienna in 1797, is considered one of the most important composers of the early Romantic era, having composed over 600 Lieder, several symphonies, chamber music, and operas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Johann Strauss II, known as the "Waltz King," was born in Vienna in 1825 and composed more than 500 works, including over 150 waltzes, polkas, quadrilles, and operettas.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Anton Bruckner, born in Upper Austria in 1824, is considered one of the most important symphonists of the 19th century, having written nine symphonies, several masses, motets, and other sacred works.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Arnold Schoenberg, born in Vienna in 1874, is known for developing the twelve-tone technique and wrote several operas, chamber music, and other works.
